majority_rule: Port of data/write-triage-stronger-models-2026-09-30/score_models.py::truth_l2 (primary = truth_l1: check2 population verdict, else check3 primary verdict). With a=primary, b=second, c=third and binaries(v)=(v=='CORRECTS', v in {RELATED,UNRELATED}): (1) if binaries(a)==binaries(b) and neither is UNCLEAR, the verdict is a (the PRIMARY word, even when b is a different word with the same binaries; third is not consulted). (2) Otherwise c is consulted; the verdict is the plurality word of (a,b,c) if some word occurs >=2 times (ties impossible with 3 votes). (3) If all three differ: CORRECTS if >=2 of them are CORRECTS (cannot occur when all differ; kept for fidelity), else RELATED if >=2 are in {RELATED,UNRELATED}, else c if binaries(c)==(False,False), else EXTENDS. 'misfile' = majority verdict in {RELATED, UNRELATED}.
